understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels by positioning every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked '+'; on multi-goal levels, all goals must be occupied simultaneously for the level to register WIN, and completing the final level wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controls the currently selected piece (shown as P in the semantic grid) and moves it one 3-pixel cell per MOVE action unless blocked by walls/bounds; adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed in the move direction if space/behavior allows. Levels may include multiple selectables (others shown as S), and control switches via CLICK on the selectable's exact pixel coordinate listed in the state. Walls (#) generally prevent movement but can have differing behaviors, and the movement_blocked flags are only hints (they indicate adjacency, not guaranteed failure).

history.summary: Turn 1: MOVE_RIGHT | Although all sides look blocked, walls sometimes allow sliding/teleport-like movement; try moving right first to probe for an opening or special interaction.
history.reasoning: Although all sides look blocked, walls sometimes allow sliding/teleport-like movement; try moving right first to probe for an opening or special interaction.

history.summary: Turn 2: MOVE_RIGHT | We appear enclosed, but boundaries can be nonstandard; probe by attempting to move into the adjacent wall on the right.

history.summary: Turn 3: MOVE_RIGHT | We’re boxed in by walls on all sides; the only potential interaction is to the right where the other selectable sits, so try pushing/merging by moving into it.

history.summary: Turn 7: MOVE_RIGHT | We’re adjacent to the goal area on the right; attempt to move onto it even though it’s flagged blocked (goal tiles are non-collidable).

history.reasoning: We need both selectables to cover the 3x3 goal cluster; switch to the other selectable so we can move it into the goal area while this one stays put.

history.reasoning: We’re fully enclosed by walls, so the only way to progress is to switch to the other selectable and try moving it toward the goal area.
